in_latin.name: Neus
in_latin.meaning: Latin diminutive form of names starting with Neo- or New-
in_latin.long_meaning: From Latin, Neus is a diminutive form of names beginning with Neo- or New-. It is derived from the Greek prefix Neo- (νέος), meaning new, fresh, or recent. In early Christian tradition, Neus may have been used as a diminutive form of names associated with renewal or rebirth, such as Neo- or Neophytos. While Neus is not a direct biblical name, its etymology and historical usage evoke themes of spiritual rebirth and renewal, characteristic of Christian tradition.
